iti7:1.1: 7 vuttaṃ hetaṃ bhagavatā vuttamarahatāti me sutaṃ
iti7:2.1: sabbaṃ bhikkhave anabhijānaṃ aparijānaṃ tattha cittaṃ avirājayaṃ appajahaṃ abhabbo dukkhakkhayāya
iti7:2.2: sabbañca kho bhikkhave abhijānaṃ parijānaṃ tattha cittaṃ virājayaṃ pajahaṃ bhabbo dukkhakkhayāyāti.
iti7:4.1: ayampi attho vutto bhagavatā iti me sutanti.
